# everflow Provider

The Everflow provider manages affiliate marketing resources (advertisers, offers, affiliates) in an Everflow network account via the Everflow Network API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everflow = {
      source  = "BorrowBetter/everflow"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Authenticate via the `api_key` attribute or the EVERFLOW_API_KEY
# environment variable. The base_url attribute is optional and only
# useful for test overrides; production deployments should leave it unset.
provider "everflow" {
  api_key = var.everflow_api_key
}

variable "everflow_api_key" {
  description = "Everflow Network API key (X-Eflow-Api-Key)."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Everflow Network API key sent as the `X-Eflow-Api-Key` header on every request. May also be set via the `EVERFLOW_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL for the Everflow Network API. Defaults to `https://api.eflow.team`. Primarily useful for test overrides.
